messages.author: e70ce5c62ffb55cc
messages.subject: Correlation between two scale
parts:
Hi everyone,

I have two scales and they both have a good fit. Now I want to evaluate the correlation between the two scales. Do I only need to calculate mean scores of the two scale and then use cor() to get correlation between them. I am still wandering if I use this strategy because I have some adjustments for the two scale so that they both have a better fit. Could anyone so kindly to show me how to calculate the correlation?

Thank you very much,
Tony

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Correlation between two scale
parts: Could anyone so kindly to show me how to calculate the correlation?

This is not a question about the lavaan software, you should just estimate both scales in the same CFA model, and the standardized covariance between the factors will tell you the correlation.

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/cfa.html

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/inspect.html

SEMNET is a larger forum for more general SEM questions.

http://www2.gsu.edu/~mkteer/semnet.html
